## Summary

AI/ML engineer with three internships shipping LLM systems (local-LLM claims adjudication, enterprise RAG, production APIs). Builds agentic and RAG systems with measured evaluation, deterministic guardrails and human-in-the-loop safety.

## Professional experience

### Capstone Engineer (IntelliOps) — Deloitte Capstone Programme (Aug 2026 – Sep 2026)

- Built IntelliOps, an agentic AIOps platform: seven Python (FastAPI) microservices over Redis Streams and PostgreSQL with a React operator console, grouping alert storms into incidents, ranking root causes and running reversible remediation on Kubernetes with automatic rollback.
- Limited the LLM agent to a closed set of remediation actions behind a fail-closed human-approval gate with a full audit trail; playbooks graduate to automatic only after a record of verified fixes, and every outcome feeds back as training data.
- Built pluggable anomaly detectors and a seeded benchmark harness: the robust seasonal detector cuts the false-positive rate 7x (0.014 to 0.002), enforced in CI; 860+ tests.

### AI Engineering Intern — Niva Bupa Health Insurance (May 2026 – Jul 2026)

- Built a claims auto-adjudication engine for the ReAssure 3.0 health policy: a 7-gate pipeline (policy, member, coverage, waiting period, exclusion, financial, state update) mixing deterministic rules with an LLM that runs locally (Gemma on llama.cpp) or through a cloud API (Groq).
- Forced schema-valid JSON output with GBNF grammar-constrained decoding and built 4-tier confidence routing that sends uncertain claims to operations, clinical or senior-auditor review queues instead of forcing an automated verdict.
- Built a DAG rule planner (Kahn's topological sort) for audit-replayable plans, async FastAPI with per-gate SSE streaming, OCR + LLM extraction from discharge summaries, and a 77-test pytest suite that runs without a live LLM.
- Cut LLM calls per bill line item from ~11 to 1 by batching exclusion screening into a single call.

### Backend Engineering Intern — TechLearn (Feb 2026 – May 2026)

- Shipped the Dashboard Stats API serving real-time KPIs to educators, now the primary analytics endpoint in production.
- Replaced offset pagination with cursor-based pagination on submission retrieval, removing deep-page scan cost; added composite indexes and restructured trend queries to cut redundant aggregation passes.

### AI Development Intern — Path Infotech (Jun 2025 – Aug 2025)

- Deployed an enterprise RAG assistant on company servers for internal knowledge retrieval, building the semantic search pipeline with custom Azure Cognitive Search indexing skillsets for PDFs.
- Built a citation layer backed by MySQL tagging so every generated answer rendered clickable source references, making outputs auditable for non-technical staff.

## Projects

### IntelliOps: Agentic AIOps Platform — Deloitte Capstone Programme 2026

Repository: https://github.com/CodexManvik/intelliops

- Seven Python (FastAPI) microservices over Redis Streams and PostgreSQL, with a React operator console. Groups alert storms into incidents, ranks root causes and runs reversible remediation on Kubernetes with automatic rollback.
- The LLM agent is limited to a closed set of remediation actions behind a fail-closed human-approval gate; playbooks graduate to automatic only after a record of verified fixes, and outcomes feed back as training data.
- Pluggable anomaly detectors (online z-score, robust median/MAD seasonal, trained Isolation Forest) with a seeded benchmark harness (docs/BENCHMARKS.md): the robust detector cuts the seasonal false-positive rate 7x (0.014 to 0.002), enforced in CI.
- Grafana, Loki and Prometheus observability, a full audit trail and 860+ tests.

### Claims Auto-Adjudication Engine — Niva Bupa internship

Repository: https://github.com/CodexManvik/policy-automate

- 7-gate pipeline (policy, member, coverage, waiting period, exclusion, financial, state update) with deterministic rules and an LLM reasoning over discharge summaries with GBNF-constrained JSON; runs on a local LLM (Gemma on llama.cpp) or a cloud API (Groq).
- Batching exclusion screening cut LLM calls per bill line item from ~11 to 1; 4-tier confidence routing sends uncertain claims to human review queues; 77 tests.

### Interview Mirror — AI interview panel (team of 2, with Archit Badoni)

Live: https://interview-mirror-hy2n.vercel.app

- A three-person AI panel (technical, manager, HR) that takes turns, each with its own Azure neural TTS voice; questions are generated from the candidate's resume and target job description.
- Groq-hosted LLMs and Groq Whisper speech-to-text; on-device MediaPipe body-language analysis, so video never leaves the browser.
- Evidence-based scoring (two LLM graders, a tie-break pass, a transcript evidence check) with LLM fallbacks, timeouts and cooldowns; 950+ backend and 300+ frontend tests in CI.

### Aethel: Local-First Desktop AI Agent — llama.cpp, FastAPI, Tauri, MCP, LanceDB

Repository: https://github.com/CodexManvik/Aethel

- Shipped v2.0.0-beta.1 with a Windows installer (GitHub Releases). Runs multi-step PC tasks through an MCP tool hub with permission manifests, approval gates and one-click rollback.
- Reflective Skill Memory: skills compile into LLM-free macros after 3 identical runs. A CPU-only decision model (~0.2 s per call) routes intent at 0.91 precision and recall on held-out labelled data.
- Voice, personas and image generation; 790+ tests.

### DWT-CNN Invisible Image Watermarking — TensorFlow

Repository: https://github.com/CodexManvik/Deep-Learning-Based-Watermarking

- First-authored an end-to-end differentiable encode-attack-decode CNN embedding a 256-bit payload in the Haar DWT LL subband; 4.1M parameters, ~18 ms inference per image on an RTX 3050. Manuscript in preparation.
- Made JPEG differentiable (straight-through DCT quantization) in a 6-attack simulator; trained on 50K mixed-domain images to 37.3 dB PSNR, 0.97 SSIM, 3.2% BER, with 2.4–7x lower BER than a classical DWT baseline.

### Agentic RAG for Distributed Content — LangGraph

Repository: https://github.com/CodexManvik/Agentic-Rag-for-Distributed-Content

- Built a LangGraph agent pipeline (plan, retrieve, adequacy check, reformulate, synthesize, citation validation) over hybrid vector + BM25 retrieval, abstaining instead of hallucinating when evidence is weak or a query is out of policy.
- Wrote an evaluation harness (Hit@k, MRR, citation precision, abstain precision/recall); tuned profile reached 0.690 Hit@k and 0.549 MRR at 28.8 s median latency on local models and blocked all prompt-injection test queries.

### Other projects

- FloatChat-AI (https://github.com/CodexManvik/FloatChat-AI): Smart India Hackathon 2025 national semi-finalist. Questions over Argo ocean data (438 floats, 3,891 profiles, 88,541 measurements; Indian Ocean, Jan–Mar 2024) route to NL-to-SQL (templates plus LLM-written SQL, validated as a single read-only SELECT) or ChromaDB semantic search with region, month and oxygen filters; any OpenAI-compatible LLM (Groq, Ollama); FastAPI, Streamlit, Docker Compose.
- Sofia (https://github.com/CodexManvik/Sofia-A-Chatbot-For-Realtime-Document-Insights): enterprise RAG assistant built at Path Infotech on Azure OpenAI and Cognitive Search, with a citation layer.
- MusicGen (https://github.com/CodexManvik/automatic-music-generation): 2-layer LSTM (PyTorch) trained on Schubert piano MIDI parsed with music21, generating new MIDI autoregressively.
